_comment: The statuses a character can be under, shown in the character sheet's
Statuses section. Read by src/js/statuses.js, which is the only file that
A status is { id, name, description, derived? }.
id          stable, and never derived from position - a character's
statuses are saved as a list of these ids.
derived     optional. Names a fact the app works out for itself rather
than one the player picks: such a status is never offered
in the picker, never saved, and is shown only while the fact
encumbered        the inventory reaches the Encumbered zone
or weighs more than Strength x 15 lb
heavilyEncumbered the same for Heavily Encumbered
description Markdown, and may be an array for anything multi-line - the
same rules as data/classes.json, which documents them in full.
Order is the order the picker lists them in.

statuses.name: Blinded
description: - You can't see, and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.
- Attack rolls against you have **Advantage**; your attack rolls have **Disadvantage**.

statuses.name: Charmed
description: - You can't attack the charmer or target them with damaging abilities or magical effects.
- The charmer has **Advantage** on ability checks to interact with you socially.

statuses.name: Deafened
statuses.description: You can't hear, and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

statuses.name: Exhaustion
description: Cumulative, up to 6 levels; at level 6 you die.
- Each level gives **−2** to every D20 Test and **−5 ft** of Speed.
- A Long Rest removes one level.

statuses.name: Frightened
description: - **Disadvantage** on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in sight.
- You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

statuses.name: Grappled
description: - Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
- **Disadvantage** on attack rolls against anyone other than the grappler.
- The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, at the cost of extra movement.

statuses.name: Incapacitated
description: - You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.
- Your Concentration is broken, and you can't speak.
- If you're Incapacitated when you roll Initiative, you have **Disadvantage** on the roll.

statuses.name: Invisible
description: - **Advantage** on Initiative rolls.
- You aren't affected by anything that requires its target to be seen, unless the creature can somehow see you.
- Attack rolls against you have **Disadvantage**; your attack rolls have **Advantage** — unless a creature can somehow see you.

statuses.name: Paralyzed
description: - You're **Incapacitated**, and your Speed is 0.
- You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
- Attack rolls against you have **Advantage**; any hit from within 5 ft is a Critical Hit.

statuses.name: Petrified
description: Turned to an inanimate substance, along with anything you're wearing or carrying.
- Your weight increases tenfold and you stop aging.
- You're **Incapacitated**, your Speed is 0, and attack rolls against you have **Advantage**.
- You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
- **Resistance** to all damage, and **Immunity** to the Poisoned condition.

statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.description: **Disadvantage** on attack rolls and ability checks.

statuses.name: Prone
description: - Your only movement options are to crawl, or to spend half your Speed to stand up.
- **Disadvantage** on your attack rolls.
- Attack rolls against you have **Advantage** from within 5 ft, **Disadvantage** from farther away.

statuses.name: Restrained
description: - Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
- Attack rolls against you have **Advantage**; your attack rolls have **Disadvantage**.
- **Disadvantage** on Dexterity saving throws.

statuses.name: Stunned
description: - You're **Incapacitated**.
- You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
- Attack rolls against you have **Advantage**.

statuses.name: Unconscious
description: - You're **Incapacitated** and **Prone**, drop whatever you're holding, and are unaware of your surroundings.
- Your Speed is 0, and you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
- Attack rolls against you have **Advantage**; any hit from within 5 ft is a Critical Hit.

statuses.name: Concentrating
description: Maintaining a spell or effect that requires Concentration.
- Taking damage calls for a Constitution save (DC 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher, up to 30) to keep it.
- It ends if you're Incapacitated or die, or if you start another Concentration effect.

statuses.name: Encumbered
description: Carrying more than **Strength × 15 lb**, or packed into the inventory's Encumbered zone.
- Your Speed drops by **10 ft**.

statuses.name: Heavily Encumbered
description: Carrying more than **Strength × 30 lb**, or packed into the inventory's Heavily Encumbered zone.
- Your Speed drops by **20 ft**.
- **Disadvantage** on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws that use Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution.
